Results.ReviewText: I came to the site to do some research because I am thinking about buying a gas grill for super quick weeknight use, and Weber is a trusted brand to me. But I'm not sure I really need one. My Weber kettle is 16 years old and is still going strong. I bought it marked down at a local big-box retailer many years ago. Overall I prefer charcoal to gas and think it gives better flavor. With the Weber chimney starter, start up time is very fast. (What a great invention!) I have made everything from burgers and veggies to a Thanksgiving turkey. I have done fast seared steaks, low-and-slow pork shoulder with smoke and everything in between. If I DO get a gas grill I expect my kettle to sit beside it. I think the gas grill might be sexier, but my kettle is perfection itself!
Results.Title: perfection itself

Results.ReviewText:
I was given this as a wedding anniversary present after being asked what we wanted for a gift from my parents.  I have a friend who strongly recommended it as a smoker, so we figured we would get one.  So far, we love it.  He had said he has owned a traditional side box smoker and a vertical smoker, and the Kettle outperformed both of them in terms of ease of use as a smoker.  Easy to control the temperature during a long cook and not a ton of leaking around the sides.

So far, I've smoked two racks of ribs, some chicken thighs, and a pork roast on it so far and it's been some of the best bbq Ive had.... made even better knowing I was the one who cooked it, lol!  I watched a couple of tutorials and let me tell you, smoking on a kettle could not be easier with the snake method!  I do need to buy some accessories like a hinged cooking grate and a side table, but even in it's out of the box stock form, it performs perfectly.
Results.Title: Loving this grill!

Results.ReviewText: My Weber kettle finally broke. I owned it for 28 years and used it about every other week. It travelled with me from South Africa to CA to AZ to MI. No parts had been replaced. The only repairs were the addition of screws to prevent the legs from detaching. Cooking on the grill was a pleasure. Heat was distributed evenly over the surface and easily regulated. The 22" was perfect for my family. The welding on the handle has failed. The rust is starting to get under the paint so I will replace it.
